name: Sambar
instructions: 1. Pressure cook the toor dal with turmeric until soft and mashable.
2. Boil the chopped vegetables in water with salt, turmeric, and tamarind extract until tender.
3. Add the sambar powder and the cooked dal to the vegetable mixture, simmer until combined.
4. Heat coconut oil in a pan, add mustard seeds, dried red chilies, shallots, and curry leaves to create the tempering.
5. Pour the tempering over the sambar and cover immediately to trap the aroma before serving with rice.
description: Sambar is the quintessential soul food of Kerala, served as a core component of the traditional Sadya feast. It represents the harmony of lentils, seasonal vegetables, and aromatic spices, reflecting the state's reliance on fresh local produce and coconut oil.
